blocks.content:
Dear Viumo Family,

You talked, and we listened! Following your feedback, version 1.1.5 is officially live, packed with the exact fixes and improvements you requested.

Here is what’s new in this release:

• Seamless Episode Resuming: Online playback now accurately saves your progress, letting you pick up right where you left off and jump straight to the next episode.
• Offline Subtitles, Perfected: Downloaded content now supports subtitles seamlessly with transparent backgrounds—no more annoying dark overlays blocking your screen.
• Complete Download Control: You can now choose how many simultaneous downloads to run at once.
• Smart Storage & Cleanups: Say goodbye to broken files! Viumo now automatically purges empty/corrupted downloads, offers an auto-delete option for finished movies, and introduces a cleaner, more intuitive Delete UI.

A huge thank you to everyone who took the time to report bugs and share suggestions. Your detailed feedback directly shaped every single feature in this build.

Keep the feedback coming, enjoy the upgrade, and happy streaming!
